_comment: Curated local models, one per hardware tier. Deliberately short: the point
is a confident choice for a given Mac, not a catalogue to browse.
Every entry is GGUF. That is a security decision, not a convenience one:
PyTorch .bin/.pt checkpoints are Python pickles and execute arbitrary code
when loaded, which is the real 'model virus' vector. GGUF is a plain data
container with no code path, so a malicious file cannot run anything.
Only repos listed here can be downloaded, filenames are resolved from the
HuggingFace API rather than guessed, and every file is checked against the
SHA-256 that HuggingFace reports for it. See src/model_catalog.py.
CI validates every entry against the live HuggingFace API, so a repo that
was renamed or withdrawn fails the build instead of shipping as a dead

tiers.label: Light
tiers.summary: Quick and light. Good for everyday chat, summarising and drafting on a base Mac.

tiers.label: Balanced
tiers.summary: The sweet spot. Noticeably better reasoning and writing, still comfortable on 16 GB.

tiers.label: Strong
tiers.summary: Serious local capability for long documents and harder reasoning. Wants 32 GB.

tiers.label: Maximum
tiers.summary: The strong model at near-full precision. Sharpest answers, for Macs with memory to spare.
